items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Boy Eugene Porter's really talking about a band.

ctx.x: Yeah. And every register on a clarinet sounds different to me, you know.

You want to ask them, we used the album system clarinet. Oh yeah? Like Bonnie Bigger I play. Plenty of Falking. Then I changed to Burn. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Boy Eugene Porter's really talking about a band. You got anything else in there? Oh yeah, I got plenty. I made a whole list of stuff to ask you, man. What about the... Did Chalini have connections?

Yeah? Or did he just stay here? No, he's old man. Oh, I see. He's old man. He's old man. He's old man. He's old musician man. That's why I went to teach him. Yeah. He didn't play no more. Oh, I see. I thought maybe he had traveled and could get you gigs all over the country or something. He might have. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
